verification.boot_img_round_trip: mkbootimg.py pack -> unpack -> verify on the build-37 image, all three with the SAME geometry flags (--kernel_offset/--ramdisk_offset/--tags_offset/--dtb_offset/--pagesize/--base/--name/--board/--header_version/--dtbo-partition-size/--boot-partition-size). Result: payload sections AND the 2,048-byte header page are byte-identical between out/boot.img and out/boot.img.dump.repack - the round-trip is now exact, not merely payload-exact. build-36 recorded '21 differing header bytes (name[16] at 0x30, board[32] at 0x240) because unpack records neither field'; that was an artifact of calling `verify` without --name/--board, which made it re-pack from defaults - corrected here and the corrected claim is measured, not inferred.
verification.dtb_inside_kernel_section: the audited mt6768.dtb bytes appear at offset 10,647,924 inside Image.gz-dtb, immediately after the gzip stream (6 FDT blobs: 1 DTB + 5 overlays); the standalone mt6768.dtb in this directory is the same file (sha256 34a7e6b536a3a34e)
verification.dtbo: scripts/mkdtboimg.py create --page_size=4096 over the 5 built .dtbo -> total_size 371,235, 5 entries, version 0; byte-identical to build-36 (38fe681f60e7a107). `verify` on it reports the same 0-difference result when given --dtb/-b flags, and its `-b 0x0bc08000` base and `--cmdline` do not affect the packed image size
verification.dtc_round_trip: dtc -I dtb -O dts | dtc -I dts -O dtb -> byte-identical 122,474 B; 413 compatible properties, mediatek,m4u + gauge/battery block present; dtc's schema warnings (unresolved vendor phandle cells, unit-address style) are inherited from the transplanted DT, not new

Earlier notes in this workspace that said 494,022/494,530 B compared build-36's Image.gz-dtb with a different build's Image.gz (or added the 313 B of 4,096-padding that only mkdtboimg applies, not the kbuild append); those numbers are not the appended payload and are corrected here.
